caption: The drawing depicts a long, full-skirted, pale-colored dress, possibly from the 18th century, with a fitted, three-quarter sleeve bodice that has lace trim at the neckline and sleeves. The dress is decorated with delicate floral embroidery patterns in various colors including light green, yellow, blue, and pink, and is bordered with a faint brown/purple outline. Surrounding the dress are six square sample panels, each featuring a different embroidery or decorative motif. The top left square shows a zigzag floral pattern in green, pink, and blue. The center left features yellow and green feather-shaped leaves on a stem. The bottom left displays a small pink motif with curved lines. The top right has a wavy pattern decorated with blue flowers. The center right has two pink outlines of stylized figures or motifs on a pedestal-like base. The bottom right contains a blue stylized ribbon or bow shape. The background of the drawing is a light beige, and the overall coloring is done with soft, pastel watercolor tones.
title: Gown
